faqs.q: Sec. 46-69. - Sale subject to government agreement.
faqs.a:
Notwithstanding anything in this article to the contrary, any purchaser at a sale
               of real or personal property of the authority pursuant to any foreclosure of a mortgage
               of the authority shall obtain title subject to any contract between the authority
               and the government relating to the supervision by the government of the operation
               and maintenance of such property and the construction of improvements thereon.
(Code 1981, § 14-38; Ord. No. 1248, § 20, 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-222.
